title: GRN Guild Kit: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Patience, mage. Killing you now would be too easy."
Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."
"Allow me a moment to catch your breath."
"My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar." —Aszala of House Dimir
"Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to." —Lazav
"Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits." —Sign outside Dinrova Building
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir." —Szadek
"Touched by moroii" —Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"
The Gruul seek unbounded strength. The Dimir deliver cruel irony.
An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.
The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.
Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.
You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.
He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.
Izzet brains and Izzet boilers: contents under pressure.
The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!" —Trivaz, Izzet mage
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive." —Niv-Mizzet
To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.
"The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."
Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.
Tracing the horizon in a dance of wind and fire.
The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.
The outskirts of Golgari territory are guarded by more than just walls.
After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.
Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.
Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.
The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.
The rot farmer's first rite of passage is to craft a pair of work stilts.
Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity." —Jarad
To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.
He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process." —Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer
"Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."
Gorgons crave beautiful things: gems, exquisite amulets, the alabaster corpses of the petrified dead . . .
Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader." —Aurelia, to Gideon Jura
"The hard part isn't landing in the saddle. The hard part is leaping before you see it."
"Subtlety is for lawmages and spies."
The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.
Lieutenant Kos has never met a group of recruits he could not inspire or a mob he could not quell.
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him." —Dars Gostok, Firefist captain
When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.
"Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way." —Razia
Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.
Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day." —Gideon Jura, to Aurelia
Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.
Izzet-designed conductors atop Sunhome charge empty sets of armor that give form to the fluctuating elementals.
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride." —Agrus Kos
Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.
There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.
Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity." —Niszka, Selesnya evangel
From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.
The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.
No one in the Conclave acts alone.
Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.
Instructors at the Kasarna training grounds are capable healers in case their students fail to grasp the subtleties of combat.
"We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost."
The righteous light of Selesnya is channeled through the devout, striking out to blind the nonbelievers.
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness." —Trostani
"I have lived long, and I remember how this city once was. If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it."
"We in the Conclave have a saying: 'When you hold a shield, lend your shield.' The strong must never forget what they owe to the weak." — Niszka, Selesnya evangel
"The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade." —Trostani
Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.
The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.
